accepted.label: Everyday Applications of NLP
accepted.description: Recognize and list common everyday applications of NLP, such as autocorrect and plagiarism checkers.
coverage_criteria: List and describe two everyday NLP applications, such as autocorrect and plagiarism checking.
accepted.merge_rationale: Stands alone as a definition-level concept focusing on simple recall of familiar NLP applications, distinct from the broader, explanatory concept in sm002.

accepted.label: Broad NLP Applications with Explanation
accepted.description: List a wide range of NLP applications and explain how NLP is used in at least one, demonstrating deeper understanding beyond mere recall.
coverage_criteria: Citar pelo menos cinco aplicações de PLN.
Escolher uma aplicação e explicar como o PLN é usado.
accepted.merge_rationale: Stands alone because it adds the material behavior of explaining how NLP works in a specific application, going beyond simple listing and requiring a deeper level of understanding.
